summary:
Implementation plan for:
1. Three purchaseable & upgradeable Free Upgrade stats (Free Damage, Free Defense, Free Utilities) granting +0.25% per level, rolling at wave end with explicit announcements.
2. Complete Settings UI overhaul and removal of the projectile setting inside Fire Protocol in the Gameplay settings tab.
3. Simplified, consistent, and reliable Death Summary / Game Over UI.
4. Reworked pure wave and tier Boss scaling without player DPS rubberbanding.
